task.title: Build 55 Activity freshness failure: read-only diagnostic

result.summary: Diagnostic only (no code, production, policy, ASC or Codex-worktree changes). Activity is stale on the SERVER, not just the UI: the last accepted Activity observation for 2026-09-23 is sourceRevision 50 at 18:35:26Z (11:35 PDT) = the canonical day rev 50 the Log shows. Since 22:02:36Z (first fresh Build 55 process) every foreground and Log pull-to-refresh produced an ingest request that the Server rejected 409 HEALTHKIT_OBSERVATION_IDENTITY_COLLISION (10 attempts through 01:07:03Z; 409s write no receipt). So the query fires, the upload is sent and reaches the Server, and the Build 55 timeout/rerun/serialization fixes are engaged -- this is a NEW failure mode, not the Build 54 wedge. Mechanism: the device re-sends an already-consumed per-day sourceRevision for activity-summary:automatic:2026-09-23 with newer content; abandon-on-rejection never advances the cursor, so the loop is permanent for the day and clears only at local midnight. Trigger not distinguishable from the Server (409 bodies not stored): an acknowledge-loss leaving the device cursor at 49 (Build 54 wedge era or Build 55's new cancellation check between upload and acknowledge) or a dropped cursor entry restarting at 1 (aged-out-day deletion path or locked-device state-file quarantine). Nutrition shares the identical mechanism and is fresh only because nothing changed after 14:35 PDT. Build 55 changed none of the revision/persistence code. No app screen surfaces the automatic scope diagnostics.

tests.summary: Read-only diagnostic; no code changed. Evidence: doctl deployment/spec verification, production web logs 19:32Z-01:07Z, three zero-write console probes at runtime 31c88481 (observations/canonical days/receipts, acceptance audit Sep 22-24), local ASC receipt logs, and a fresh-context read-only audit of Native 621dbef3 vs e249a0f3.

review.summary: Native mechanism reviewed with file:line citations (HealthKitQueryClient.swift:26-32,261-280,314-318; HealthKitSynchronizationEngine.swift:482,499-501; HealthKitSyncPersistence.swift:114-128,206-231,240; LogView.swift:52-58). Client cache ruled out (90 s in-memory TTL invalidated by pull-to-refresh; Server holds rev 50).

zero_write_audit.summary: All production access read-only (REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY + ROLLBACK, hashed ids, no values). Strategic eligibility 0 for every HealthKit record; canonical days Sep 23: activity rev 50 (partial_day, 18:35Z), nutrition rev 3 (21:35Z).

decisions_required: Coordinate the Native fix with Codex (not started): advance the day's revision floor on identity-collision abandon; per-day high-water revision that never regresses; uncancellable acknowledge after a durable upload; do not quarantine the state file on locked-device I/O failure.
Server companions (safe, independent): carry nextExpectedRevision in the 409 body and log the hashed external id + sourceRevision on the 409 warn line; do not silently accept lower revisions.
Operator visibility: surface the automatic scopes' persisted diagnostics (lastErrorCode, abandonedBatchCount, cursorGeneration, lastDurableAcknowledgement) on the existing canary screen.
unexpected_findings: 409 identity collisions write no command receipt, so the receipts table looks silent while the device is actively retrying; only the web logs show the rejections.
Nutrition carries the same latent loop (identical revision/cursor mechanism); it survived only for lack of new data.
Build 55 introduced a new acknowledge-loss window (30 s step timeout can cancel between a durably accepted upload and the local acknowledge), a plausible trigger for exactly this one-revision offset.

The 2026-09-23 Activity day will stay frozen at the 11:35 PDT value until a fixed device re-emits it with a fresh revision; Activity will appear to recover on its own after local midnight because 2026-09-24's revision numbers are unused.
backlog: Native: revision floor on collision abandon + high-water revision + uncancellable acknowledge + state-file load hardening (Activity and Nutrition builders).
Server: nextExpectedRevision in 409 body; hashed identity + revision in the 409 log line.
Native: automatic-scope diagnostics on the canary screen.
Rerun-after-in-flight guarantees only one fresh pass; a pull during the queued rerun coalesces onto a pass that predates it (secondary staleness hazard).
recommended_next_step: Founder: no device action; do not force-quit (the cursor is persisted). Confirm passively after local midnight that Activity resumes for 2026-09-24. ChatGPT: route the Native fix to Codex after its Strength task; Server companions can ship independently.
